QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) carves allocations out of a caller-supplied buffer and never calls `calloc`/`free`. It installs its own functions via `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function, but never says it is the only in-tree user of the runtime setter.
